label: Bible Study
prompt: No _____ that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
verse: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
note: A promise to God's servants — weapons may be formed, but they won't prosper.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the _____; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
note: God's coming is as sure as the morning and as refreshing as rain — the sunrise always shows up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to _____.
verse: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
note: Paul's short list of Christian habits includes this one: 'given to hospitality' — keep the door open.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very _____ with me.
verse: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.
note: Naomi means 'pleasant' and Mara 'bitter' — she renamed herself after losing her husband and sons in Moab.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: This know also, that in the last days _____ times shall come.
verse: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
note: 'Perilous times' in the last days — then Paul lists them: lovers of self, lovers of money, lovers of pleasure.
